def campReq (pre : Bool) (id y T : w64) (e : entryID) (cl : List w8) : Msg :=
  Msg.mkV (vreqTy pre) id y T false e.index' e.term' (W64 0) (W64 0) [] [] cl

theorem sendMsgs_log [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (s0 : NState) (ms : List Msg) :
    (sendMsgs s0 ms).log = s0.log

def vrespTy (pre : Bool) : MsgType :=
  if pre = true then MsgType.preVoteResp else MsgType.voteResp

def vrespW32 (pre : Bool) : w32 :=
  if pre = true then MsgPreVoteResp else MsgVoteResp

def campRoleState [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (id : w64) (s : NState) (pre : Bool) :
    NState :=
  if pre = true then becomePrecandidate s else becomeCandidate id s

def vreqW32 (pre : Bool) : w32 :=
  if pre = true then MsgPreVote else MsgVote

theorem sendMsgs_logst [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (s0 : NState) (ms : List Msg) :
    (sendMsgs s0 ms).logst = s0.logst

theorem campRoleState_logst [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (id : w64) (s : NState) (pre :
    Bool) : (campRoleState id s pre).logst = s.logst

def campMsg (pre : Bool) (id T : w64) (e : entryID) (cl : List w8) (y : w64) : Msg :=
  if y = id then Msg.plain (vrespTy pre) id id T false else campReq pre id y T e cl

theorem sendMsgs_app [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (s0 : NState) (ms1 ms2 : List Msg) :
    sendMsgs (sendMsgs s0 ms1) ms2 = sendMsgs s0 (ms1 ++ ms2)

def vreqTy (pre : Bool) : MsgType :=
  if pre = true then MsgType.preVote else MsgType.vote

theorem perm_id_cons (cfg : GSet w64) (id : w64) (xs : List w64) (Hid : id ∈ cfg) (Hnd : xs.Nodup)
    (Hmem : ∀ (z : w64), z ∈ xs ↔ z ∈ cfg) : xs.Perm (id :: elements (cfg \ {id}))
